General map showing selected buildings and residences with names of owners.

General map showing selected buildings and residences with names of owners. Served as basis for 1853 printed version, "Map of Norfolk, Litchfield County, Ct., surveyed and drawn by L. Fagan." Relief shown by hachures. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Includes inset of village of Norfolk. Imperfect: Brittle, torn, soiled, mounted on cloth backing, village inset cut out after mounting and then sewed back on. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
